closedDecisions.references: Existing references JSON has exactly variables,secrets,authoringIdentityVersion:1,authoredDeclarations sorted by UTF-8 referenceId. Context uses exact StudioVariable.name; secret tokens use declared secretId. Missing/ambiguous references fail. Secret dot/dotdot rejected. No new revision column.
closedDecisions.historicalBase: Read only immutable revision identity. Incomplete base refuses implicit reuse. Explicit first current step is full learning without reuse and may refresh only current derived cache after full source/config CAS; V12 captures it; old revision untouched.
closedDecisions.prefixMode: Immutable relearn_plan, pending predicate initialIndex>0 and no switch. State and continuation REPLAYING_PREFIX remain stable; attempt and counter guards apply even during PREPARING. One-way switch to SOURCE_PLAN.
closedDecisions.prefixProgram: Exact canonical closed schemaVersion/baseRevisionId/baseRevisionDigest/sourceStepIds/actions envelope; actions from base learnedPlan minus admissionId plus exact artifact guard. No raw values/old authorization.
closedDecisions.materialization: Normalized immutable headers (versions1..201) and input entries (ordinals0..199), reconstructed snapshots, exact deferred head FK. Same context/browser/scope/source/config/worker/fence. Nonempty append only in MATERIALIZE, old+1 checked revision and exact old entry prefix. 32768 canonical UTF-8 bytes per input, 1MiB canonical full payload/aggregate entries, max200 inputs.
closedDecisions.noInflight: Append and prepare/admit/consume serialize on session lock. Append refuses ADMITTED, DISPATCHING, UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, unexpired unconsumed preparations and pending delivery. Stale old proof fails current-version/ACK gate; historical completed proof remains verifiable.
closedDecisions.delivery: Every pinned-base session carries immutable paired prefixProgram/prefixProgramHash through prefix and suffix, including EMPTY_PREFIX. No-plan sessions omit both. Append>=2 creates PENDING. Freeze complete RunnerContext metadata minus authoredInputs once; reconstruct pinned inputs to hash exact whole issued context. ACK exact delivery/version/input hash/context hash/birth materialization revision and full scope/owner/source identity; original issued lease remains immutable and must still be valid. No actions/model/counter/bump until ACK. Initial version uses existing bootstrap, no fabricated historical ACK.
closedDecisions.noInvocation: Closed PRE_ADMISSION or ADMITTED_PRE_INVOCATION receipt. Same current worker RS256/mTLS verified by existing outcome callback; receiptHash is integrity, never authentication. SQL binds issued request, program, coordinate, current scope/source/version and consumed preparation/action for admitted branch. Exactly one receipt/switch. Actual native-count and trusted-boundary proof requires runner tests.
closedDecisions.attempts: Semantic ordinals0..7 and maxStatementsPerStep unchanged. Immutable action and association attempt_ordinal0..1; ledger field matches column. Attempt1 only for sole drift coordinate with exact admitted attempt0 no-invocation proof. Every admission counts maxActions<=200. Older document bytes remain immutable; new column0 is proven by historical single-coordinate uniqueness, not guessed usage.
closedDecisions.suffixPlan: One immutable suffix_acceptance binds new plan revision and actual retained successful admissions/meanings. Only unexecuted imports and sole proven no-invocation spent attempt can be replaced; subsequent replans stay monotonic.
closedDecisions.publication: Full metadata/maps required on new revisions. Pinned-base and actual completed-prefix keys must equal step_reuse_provenance exactly. All successful ledger actions appear once per coordinate; every excluded consumed failure requires exact receipt. learnedPlan.incremental equals immutable plan/switch. Complete graph and all versions/attempts committed by existing hashes; pure Java/runner verifier checks content and evidence.
closedDecisions.result: PublicationReceipt requires relearnedFrom even when null; omission is refused. Before committed switch, relearnedFrom=null. After BOUNDARY/DRIFT/EMPTY_PREFIX, stepId is entered effective learning boundary; driftSwitchStepId=j if drift. It never claims learning completed or publication succeeded. Initial k remains immutable session firstLearnStepId.
closedDecisions.emptyBoundary: Base+k1 gets EMPTY_PREFIX switch at index0, no prefix operation or fake receipt. Tail deletion learns last surviving step; no empty suffix/end sentinel. Delete-all start refuses before writes.
closedDecisions.retention: V19 retained-progress keys and pruner unchanged. Safe plan/switch/request/receipt/version metadata survives independently. Existing source manifests/materialized values/proposals/plans/command caches remain F01 residual; normalized entries add no distinct new values and avoid snapshot duplication. No claim that raw inputs are pruned, no Security/OBS010 retention-gate waiver.
closedDecisions.secrets: V17 ordinary RELEASE lineage uses actual historical materialization version. V17:515 remains terminal unlinked USAGE/no-decision gate. Receipt does not change existing factual release or conservative non-OK UNKNOWN_OUTCOME usage into NOT_USED. No old secret value or authorization reused.
